summary: TOP Financial Group Ltd files a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering of 6,441,012 Class A ordinary shares at $0.45645 per share for ~$2.94M gross proceeds. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing effective shelf registration statement (Form F-3), with no placement agent, board approval, proceeds for working capital, and expected close on June 25, 2026. This is an ordinary equity financing, not a special situation; no special-situation category applies.
